caption: The drawing features a central illustration of a wooden armchair with a blue upholstered seat, backrest, and padded armrests. The wooden frame of the chair is rendered in brown, with x-shaped supports between the legs, which are slightly outward-angled. The blue cushions cover the entire seat and backrest and extend over the arms. Surrounding the central colored drawing are two technical line drawings of the same chair: one in the upper left corner labeled "Side View" and one in the lower right labeled "Front View." Both technical drawings include measurements and are rendered in black pencil or ink, each with the note "Scale ⅛ = 1"” at the bottom. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color, and the overall composition is centered with the technical details flanking the main perspective view.
title: Chair
